security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A quiet scribe for your AI coding sessions
bundle.longDescription: Munshi archives your AI coding sessions as durable Markdown. This desktop addon shows the archiving backlog and drives the same actions the CLI offers; the munshi command-line tool ships inside it.
